messages:
OncallBot: INCIDENT PAGER — rate-limiter v3 rollout causing spike in 5xxs and denied requests for premium customers. Pager: @oncall
Sam: Saw the bot. I'm on it. Starting investigation.
Sam: Maria, did the v3 rollout hit canary or full? I thought we were canarying 10%.
Maria: Canary 10% in us-west initially. We promoted to 40% at 13:22 per deploy bot (see log below). Notified in friday-deploys but probably got missed.
DeployBot: deploy v3-ratecap to cluster-us-west canary -> 40% at 2026-03-15T13:22:11Z
Jake: We're seeing elevated rate-limit rejects in prod metrics: rl.errors > baseline x12. Top affected: token_accounting service and customer-tier exemptions path.
Luis: Logs show negative token delta for some exemption checks: `tokens_remaining = available - used` -> negative values passed to quota-check, which then treats as 0 and triggers throttle. Snippet:
```
# from ratecap-v3 handler
available = fetch_available_tokens(customer_id)
used = read_counter(customer_id)
tokens_remaining = available - used
if tokens_remaining <= 0:
    return throttle()
```
Luis: Root cause: a race in the counter write path where a rollback in commit left `used` inflated for some customers during burst retries.
Sam: Which customers? Are these high-value customers?
Luis: Early sample: cust-ACME, cust-NOVA, cust-ORBIT — yes enterprise tiers. Affects accounts that do heavy streaming writes and have exemptions configured.
Maria: Exemptions config seems to be present but an internal flag `exemptions_enabled` was not honored in the canary-to-prod promotion due to a config reload bug. So exemptions existed but were ignored during the promote.
Jake: That explains why premium accounts were still being throttled.
CustomerOps: We're getting inbound tickets and a slack DM from ACME support. Priority one. Their jobs failed during morning batch.
Sam: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip kill-switch to stop v3 rollout promotion (prevent further hosts) 2) revert canary to v2 on affected nodes 3) run counter repair job for suspected customers 4) notify customers and open RIT.
Maria: I'm flipping the feature flag now: `/ff toggle ratecap_v3_promote off` — done. Confirmed no new hosts are promoted.
DeployBot: feature flag ratecap_v3_promote -> OFF by Maria at 2026-03-15T13:29:02Z
Sam: Rolling back promoted hosts. Jake, coordinate with eng-sre to identify host ids. Use tag `v3-promoted-2067890123`.
Jake: Starting rollback script now: `./scripts/rollback.sh --tag v3-promoted-2067890123 --concurrency 5`
Jake: Rolling back 18/18 hosts in us-west canary subset. Health checks passing on v2 rollback.
Luis: Counter repair job queued: `repair_counters --customers cust-ACME cust-NOVA cust-ORBIT --dry-run` ran, showing mismatches. Running live fix with throttled concurrency.
Sam: CustomerOps, draft a rapid ack to customers: short explanation, mitigation steps, ETA for full resolution.
CustomerOps: Drafted message: "We're investigating intermittent throttling for some enterprise customers due to a rate-limit rollout. We've paused the rollout and reverted affected hosts. We're repairing counters and will follow up with ETA. Apologies for the disruption." Sending to ACME now.
CustomerOps: ACME confirmed they can resume some jobs; asked for root cause. We'll share postmortem.
Maria: Metrics: error rate down to baseline within 6 minutes of rollback. Token rejects decreased by 92%.
Sam: Good. Next actions: 1) collect all affected customer ids 2) run full counter audit 3) create a JIRA for root cause (race + config reload) + mitigation (stronger canary gating + invariant checks) 4) incident writeup.
Luis: I'll instrument an invariant guard in token accounting to never return negative remaining and emit alert if counters drift > 5%.
Jake: Also adding a canary check that ensures exemptions flags are respected before promotion. Add automated smoke for premium accounts.
Sam: Oncall handoff: I'm handing to Maria for monitoring and post-incident follow-through. Maria, you ok to own the postmortem?
Maria: Yes. I'll take it. I'll also coordinate support and tagging of affected customers.
OncallBot: HANDOFF — Sam has handed on-call to Maria at 2026-03-15T14:05:12Z
Sam: Thanks team. I'll help with the repair job logs. Please record any customer-impact timestamps in the incident board.
CustomerOps: ACME confirmed they saw successful retries after rollback. They're grateful for the quick response. Keeping this open until counters fully repaired.
Maria: Closing pager for now but keeping thread open for postmortem details. Will follow up with RCA draft within 24 hours. :memo:
Sam: Reactions: :thumbsup:
__notes: This thread contains root message, bot messages, and human replies describing a rate-limit rollout regression, immediate mitigation (feature flag kill-switch, rollback), counter repair, customer comms, and on-call handoff. All fields are strings or lists per agents.md.
